# Court Atlas

> Follow the 2026 tennis season: a world map of ATP and WTA tournaments, live draws with win probabilities, player form and past champions. Draws and results come from Wikipedia and refresh every 15 minutes during tournaments; win probabilities are a Court Atlas Elo estimate, not betting odds.

Draws last fetched 2026-10-16T09:14:10Z. Every page links to the Wikipedia pages it draws on. Shop links on the Strings page are affiliate links.

## Topics

- [Home](https://winterai-newchapter.github.io/Court-Atlas/): Follow the 2026 tennis season: a world map of ATP and WTA tournaments, live draws with win probabilities, player form and past champions.
- [Season Map](https://winterai-newchapter.github.io/Court-Atlas/season.html): Every 2026 ATP and WTA tournament on a world map, with finals, scores, live draws and the next matches of events in progress.
- [History](https://winterai-newchapter.github.io/Court-Atlas/history.html): Key moments in tennis from Wingfield’s 1874 patent to electronic line calling, plus the all-time Grand Slam singles title leaders.
- [Past Champions](https://winterai-newchapter.github.io/Court-Atlas/archive.html): Every Australian Open, Roland Garros, Wimbledon and US Open singles champion since 2000, with a most-majors leaderboard by era.
- [Rackets](https://winterai-newchapter.github.io/Court-Atlas/rackets.html): Head size, strung weight and string pattern for popular Babolat, Head, Wilson, Yonex and Tecnifibre frames, and which pros use them.
- [Strings](https://winterai-newchapter.github.io/Court-Atlas/strings.html): Answer seven questions to get a string type, gauge and tension for your game, then compare popular strings and hybrids and learn when to restring.
- [Players](https://winterai-newchapter.github.io/Court-Atlas/players.html): Profiles of the 2026 ATP and WTA top 10 with recent form, win rate by surface and Elo, plus a page for every player in the covered draws.
- [Statistics](https://winterai-newchapter.github.io/Court-Atlas/stats.html): Charts of 2026 ATP and WTA ranking points, title counts across covered tournaments and career Grand Slam titles for the top 10.
